name: Nizwa Old Town and Souq
tagline: The historic heart around the fort and market
description: The atmospheric core of Nizwa, wrapped around the great round fort, the Friday Mosque and the restored souq. Heritage guesthouses, silversmiths, date stalls and the famous Friday livestock market are all here. It is the most walkable, characterful and culturally immersive base in town.
bestFor: Culture lovers and short-stay visitors who want to be in the thick of it
pros: Walkable to the fort, mosque and souq
Front-row seat for the Friday souq
cons: Busy and noisy around market days

name: Firq
tagline: Practical residential Nizwa just south of the centre
description: A settled residential district a short drive south of the old town, Firq is where much of everyday Nizwa lives. Expect villas, local shops, mosques and easy access to the main highway. It is quieter and more practical than the historic core, and a sensible base for a longer, car-based stay.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting affordable, everyday residential life
pros: Everyday shops and services close by
cons: Little to do within walking distance

name: Birkat al Mawz
tagline: Palm-fringed falaj village at the gateway to Jebel Akhdar
description: A green oasis village east of Nizwa, famous for its date plantations, the restored Bait al Redidah fort and the aflaj water channels that thread through the palms. It sits at the turnoff up to Jebel Akhdar, making it a scenic, tranquil base for mountain day trips.
bestFor: Nature lovers and hikers using it as a mountain launchpad
cons: A 4x4 helps for the mountain climb

name: Al Hamra and Misfat al Abriyeen
tagline: Old mud-brick villages and terraces west of Nizwa
description: A scenic cluster west of Nizwa, where Al Hamra preserves centuries-old mud-brick houses and nearby Misfat al Abriyeen clings to a terraced hillside above date gardens and falaj channels. A handful of guesthouses make it a memorable, photogenic base for exploring the western Hajar.
bestFor: Photographers and travellers wanting an immersive village stay
cons: Steep, narrow lanes and limited parking
